note: nominative, subject of *habeat* (ἡ δὲ ὑπομονὴ ἔργον τέλειον ἐχέτω), not the ablative *Patientiā* proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
ablative with *rē*, governed by *careātis* (*nūllā rē careātis*, ἐν μηδενὶ λειπόμενοι), not the nominative proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
ablative with *caret* (*sī quis vestrum sapientiā caret*, λείπεται σοφίας), not the nominative proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
ablative after *cum* (*cum fīdūciā*, ἐν πίστει), not the nominative proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)

*decōra speciēs* (ἡ εὐπρέπεια), nominative feminine of the adjective *decōrus* (Gaffiot *dĕcōrus*; the lexicon's *decōra*), not *decora* (plural of *decus*) as proposed; your settled *decōrum*, *decōre*, *decōrās* (Claude, 2026-11-12)
nominative with *umbra* (*aut ūlla conversiōnis umbra*), as *nūlla … mūtātiō* before it; the stem long as your settled *ūllā* 11, *ūlla* 5 (Claude, 2026-11-12)
nominative, second subject of *est* (*nūlla est mūtātiō, aut ūlla … umbra*, τροπῆς ἀποσκίασμα), not the ablative *umbrā* proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
adverb of *cōmis* (courteously, ἐν πραΰτητι), Gaffiot *cōmĭter*, not *comiter* (of *comitor*) as proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
ablative after *in* (*in eā mānserit*, abides in the law, παραμείνας), not the neuter plural *ea* proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)

*aureōs … annulōs* (χρυσοδακτύλιος); spelled with nn (as the draft and 1573's *anulos* aside), the a short before it as your settled *annulum* 2, *annulus* 1 (Gaffiot heads *ānŭlus*, with *annŭlus* beside it), not *ānnulōs* as proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
ablative after *in* with *veste* (*in obsolētā veste*, ἐν ῥυπαρᾷ ἐσθῆτι), as *in veste splendidā* before it, not the nominative proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
adverb, here (*tū sedē hīc pulchrē*, κάθου ὧδε καλῶς), not the pronoun *hic* proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
adverb, here (*aut hīc sub meō subselliō sedē*, ὧδε), not the pronoun *hic* proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
*lēgī pārētis rēgiæ* (you obey the royal law; νόμον τελεῖτε), of *pāreō*, not *parētis* (of *parō*, subjunctive) as proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
masculine nominative (*quī dīxit … īdem dīxit*, ὁ γὰρ εἰπών … εἶπεν καί), not the neuter *idem* proposed; as your Gal 2:8 *īdem* (Claude, 2026-11-12)
ablative with *pāce* (*bonā cum pāce*, ἐν εἰρήνῃ), not the neuter plural proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
ablative after *in* (*in ārā lībandō*, ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον), of *āra* (Gaffiot *āra*, the lexicon's *āra*; your settled *ārā* 2), not *arā* (of *arō*) as proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)

perfect subjunctive in the indirect question (*ut fidēs ejus opera adjūverit*, συνήργει), the perfect stem *adjūv-* (Gaffiot *adjŭvō, jūvī*; the lexicon's *adiūverit* [MW]), not *adjuverit* as proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)

nominative, subject (*Itidem Rāchaba meretrīx … jūstificāta est*, Ῥαὰβ ἡ πόρνη), not the ablative *Rāchabā* proposed (your settled *Rāchabā* is an ablative); the stem as there; no source knows the name (Claude, 2026-11-12)
ablative with *viā* (*aliā viā ēmissīs*, ἑτέρᾳ ὁδῷ), not the nominative proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
nominative, subject (*Sīc et lingua … magnās vīrēs habet*, ἡ γλῶσσα), not the ablative proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
nominative, subject (*Et lingua ignis est*), not the ablative proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
nominative, subject (*Sīc sē habet … lingua*), not the ablative proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
ablative after *ā* (*ā gehennā īnflammanda*, ὑπὸ τῆς γεέννης), not the nominative proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
ablative, instrument (*Eā Deum et Patrem collaudāmus*, with it, the tongue; ἐν αὐτῇ), not the neuter plural *Ea* proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
ablative, as *Eā* (*eādem hominēs exsecrāmur*, καὶ ἐν αὐτῇ) (Claude, 2026-11-12)
ablative with *mānat* (*dulcī aquā mānat et amārā*, flows with sweet water and bitter), agreeing with *dulcī*, not the nominative proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
ablative, as *aquā* (*et amārā*), not the nominative proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)

accusative plural, figs (*aut vītis fīcūs ēdere*, σῦκα), 4th declension (Gaffiot *fīcŭs, ūs*), not the nominative *fīcus* proposed; the first *fīcus* (the fig tree, subject) stays; your settled *fīcūs* 1 (Claude, 2026-11-12)
neuter accusative plural with *opera* (*ostendat … sua opera*, τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ), not the ablative proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
nominative, subject (*Ubi enim invidia est et simultās*, ζῆλος), not the ablative proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)

perfect of *lascīviō* (ἐσπαταλήσατε), contracted from *lascīviistis* (1573 *laſciuijſtis*, canvas 919; the lexicon's *lascīviistis*, Gaffiot *lascīvĭō, ĭī*), the long ī of the contraction as your settled *audīstis*; no source knows the contracted form (Claude, 2026-11-12)
*misericors et clēmēns* (οἰκτίρμων), nominative of *clēmēns* (Gaffiot *clēmēns*; the lexicon's *clēmēns* [MW]), long e before ns, not *clēmens* as proposed (Claude, 2026-11-12)
